item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera's teacher brings a piece of granite rock to class. Meera says, "Rocks, minerals, and metals are all the same thing." Her friend Arjun explains the correct relationship and also tells her why rocks must be used carefully.

Which statement is correct?

options.A: Rocks are made up of metals, and rocks can be used without limits because they are visible everywhere.
options.B: Minerals are made up of rocks, and only rocks used for buildings need to be conserved.
options.C: Rocks are made up of minerals, metals such as iron and copper are extracted from minerals, and rocks form so slowly that they must be used responsibly.
options.D: Rocks, minerals, and metals are different names for the same thing, so there is no need to conserve them.
